description: This file defines a PHP class WishList that manages user wishlist functionalities within an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for displaying, adding, and removing wishlist items, as well as initialization routines for controlling the wishlist page view.

classes.name: WishList
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the user's wishlist in the OpenCart system, including displaying wishlist items, adding new items, and removing existing ones.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the wishlist page, setting page title, scripts, breadcrumbs, and loading the wishlist view with data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to retrieve the wishlist list, ensures user is logged in, and outputs the wishlist view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches wishlist items, prepares product data including images, prices, stock status, and URLs, and renders the wishlist list view.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles addition of a product to the wishlist; updates session and database and returns JSON response.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles removal of a product from the wishlist; updates session and database and returns JSON response.
